本机执行，资料还会传到云端吗？: Does local execution still send data to the cloud?
会。工具在你的电脑执行，但文件内容、命令输出、网页信息或桌面截图会作为工具结果返: Yes. Tools run on your computer, but file contents, command output, web page information, or desktop screenshots return to the agent as tool results. Anyone with the shared link can also view logs and screenshots. Limit access to the task's needs and check how your cloud service handles data.
原生桌面 App 支持 macOS 12 及以上，提供 Apple Silico: The native desktop app supports macOS 12 or later, with Apple Silicon and Intel builds. The browser version supports macOS, Linux, and Windows. Native desktop screenshots and input are currently available only on macOS.

Permission switches and pause controls can only be changed locally. Terminal commands run with your account's permissions; project folder restrictions are not a system sandbox.
分享后，电脑可以关机吗？: Can I turn off my computer after sharing?
